name: etzhayyim-did-web
description: Cloudflare Worker serving did:web:etzhayyim.com DID Document at /.well-known/did.json

scripts.build:cljs: cd cljs && npm install --silent && npm run build
scripts.test:cljs: cd cljs && bb --classpath "src:test" -e '(require (quote did-web.router-test)) (let [{:keys [fail error]} (clojure.test/run-tests (quote did-web.router-test))] (System/exit (if (pos? (+ fail error)) 1 0)))'
